home.headline: Bid. Win. Own something exceptional.
home.subtitle: Discover unique products and compete in live auctions with real-time bidding. Every price, every second, straight from the auction server.
home.reviewNote: Every lot is reviewed and approved before it opens
home.liveSubtitle: Bidding is open. Prices update the moment someone moves.
home.liveEmptyBody: New lots open throughout the day. Browse what is scheduled next.
home.endingSubtitle: The last stretch. A bid in the final seconds can extend the clock.
home.upcomingSubtitle: Watch a lot now and we will tell you the moment bidding opens.
home.categoriesSubtitle: Seven collections, curated and verified before every sale.
home.howSubtitle: Three steps from browsing to owning. The server controls the clock, validates every bid and decides the winner.
home.step1Body: Browse verified lots across technology, watches, collectibles and more. Watch anything you want to follow.
home.step2Body: Bid above the minimum increment, or set an auto bid and let NexBid raise for you up to your limit.
home.step3Body: When the clock stops, the highest valid bid wins. Complete payment and your order moves to fulfilment.
home.trustTitle: Built for auctions that people trust
home.trustSubtitle: Auction integrity is an engineering problem. NexBid treats it as one.
home.trust1Body: Every bid is validated and committed in a single transaction. A confirmed bid is a recorded bid.
home.trust2Body: Prices, bid counts and countdowns stream live. No refresh, no stale numbers, no guessing.
home.trust3Body: Full bidding history on every lot, timestamped to the second and visible to everyone.
home.trust4Body: Listings are reviewed and approved before they open, and anti-sniping keeps the close fair.

howItWorks.title: How NexBid works
howItWorks.subtitle: From finding a lot to owning it — and what the server does behind every bid.
howItWorks.rule1Body: The first bid must meet the starting price. After that, every bid must clear the current price plus the seller's increment.
howItWorks.rule2Body: A confirmed bid cannot be withdrawn. If you hold the highest bid when the clock stops, you have bought the lot.
howItWorks.rule3Body: A seller is blocked from bidding on their own lot, and the server enforces it on every request.
howItWorks.rule4Body: If a bid lands in the final seconds, the auction extends so everyone gets a fair chance to respond.
howItWorks.rule5Body: Set a maximum and NexBid raises only as much as needed to keep you in front. Your maximum stays private.
howItWorks.rule6Body: Your countdown is aligned to server time. The server decides when an auction ends and who won.
howItWorks.paymentsBody: When you win, an order and a pending payment are created automatically. Complete payment before it expires and the order moves to fulfilment. Payments are mocked in this demo build.
howItWorks.selling1: Add your product with photos, condition and a full description.
howItWorks.selling2: Schedule an auction: starting price, increment, opening and closing times.
howItWorks.selling3: Submit it for review. An admin approves the lot before it opens.
howItWorks.selling4: Watch bids land in real time, then hand over once payment clears.
howItWorks.supportBody: This is a portfolio build running on mock data, so there is no live support desk. The full specification for the platform lives in the project repository.
howItWorks.ctaBody: There are lots closing in the next hour.
